QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] Ice Station 2 Dispatch
QuestInfo.1: Alviola would like you to help out her brother #bAlvesh#k. Take the boat to #b#eIce Station 2#n#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Alvesh in Ice Station 2.

0.0: I don't mean ta talk bad about folks, b'cause that's not how my mother raised me, y'know? But, holy moly, these penguins sure do make the nose twitch.
0.1: But, what're ya gonna do, y'know? Can't let these glaciers melt.
0.2: Hey, why don'tcha go and see my brother? He's a grumpy fella named Alvesh, hangs around down at #bIce Station 2#k.

yes.0: #bIce Station 2#k is just out southeast. Can't miss it.\r\n#b#e(Take the boat to Ice Station 2 and meet with Alvesh.)#k

1.0: Throughout history, heroes have been born. Are you one of those heroes?

yes.0: I am #bAlvesh#k, a hero born of the Malamute people, with a destiny to run #bIce Station 2#k.

npc.0: Ice Station 2 is just out southeast. Can't miss it.\r\n#b#e(Take the boat to Ice Station 2 and meet with Alvesh.)#k
